name: pulselink
description: PulseLink — acesso remoto P2P de baixa latência para Windows, com integração Moonlight/Sunshine

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run app -w @pulselink/desktop
scripts.app: npm run build && npm run app -w @pulselink/desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n signal,desktop -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @pulselink/signal" "npm run dev -w @pulselink/desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pulselink/protocol && npm run build -w @pulselink/signal && npm run build -w @pulselink/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build -w @pulselink/protocol && npm run build -w @pulselink/signal && npm test -w @pulselink/signal && npm run test:cloud
scripts.dist: npm run build -w @pulselink/protocol && npm run build -w @pulselink/signal && npm run dist -w @pulselink/desktop
